items.title: 73243_Joe Thomas oral history interview
items.q: And, then, let's see, with Joe Sullivan.

ctx.x: No, he played trombone. He worked for the Redman band sometime before. Do you remember Gene Simon?
Yeah. And, then, let's see, with Joe Sullivan.

James P. Did you know, you know his work. He's a tremendous person. And, since we're talking about it, I've heard a lot of things happen, you know, and he's a tremendous musician and I've heard lot of things happen with the piano and different instruments. So, one night I think John was in there, John Hammond was in there that particular night and he made a request. Now, James' approach to music was wonderful. We never played the "Charleston", we never played "Ivy Cling to Me". We never played those things. We…
